content.comment_body: I am experiencing similar issues. Previous instructions for basic usage with [product_name] and a custom cloud web server suggested activating a typical IAM user with programmatic access. Now, this process no longer works and requires manual setup. How should I proceed? Can someone from [company_name] confirm if there have been changes to the user creation process? Thank you.
Please avoid posting multiple threads about the same issue. You have also posted on the topic: AWS and LWE.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report confusion and difficulty due to updates in the process for connecting [product_name] to a custom AWS cloud server. The main issue is outdated documentation from [company_name], especially regarding the setup and configuration of IAM users for programmatic AWS access, which users note is no longer compatible with current requirements. This results in uncertainty about next steps and reduces trust in available instructions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect clear, up-to-date documentation and confirmation from [company_name] about current best practices for AWS integration, with specific guidance on IAM user creation for programmatic access.
